# Foundation tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:foundation` · Kerf UI · CSS composition · Foundation

The complete public typography, spacing, breakpoint, geometry, radius, color, focus, and shadow token surface shipped by foundation.css.

## When to use

Provide the shared semantic token foundation for application themes and every styled Kerf UI component.

- Theme a Kerf application globally or reuse the shipped semantic typography, spacing, geometry, color, focus, and shadow values in application-owned composition CSS.

**Not when:**

- Do not replace a component-specific prop or token with a broad foundation override when only one component instance should change.

## Imports

- CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/foundation.css` once.
- Declared side effects: css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- light
- dark
- increased contrast

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** application theme overrides; responsive policy at the cataloged device-class breakpoints.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: foundation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Preserve semantic contrast relationships and the visible focus ring when overriding foundation colors.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.
